# SumioPay by SumioTech

> SumioPay is India's self-hosted and cloud non-custodial Direct UPI Payment Automation & Orchestration SaaS. Businesses accept instant UPI QR and intent payments straight into their own bank accounts with 0% transaction fees, deterministic paise-offset order matching, Android notification verification, HMAC-SHA256 webhooks, and automated enterprise email payment bills.

## Key Facts (AEO / GEO Quick Summary)
- **Category:** Self-Hosted & Cloud UPI Payment Gateway Automation Software (India / INR)
- **Commission / MDR:** 0% transaction fee forever (merchant pays only a flat SaaS subscription; ₹0.00 held in escrow)
- **Settlement Timing:** Instant — 100% direct bank-to-bank via UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, CRED, HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis)
- **Pricing Plans:** 3-Day Free Trial (₹0), 1 Month Pro (₹399), 6 Months Growth (₹1,999), Custom Enterprise
- **Integration Stack:** Drop-in JS Checkout (`checkout.js`), React `<UpiCheckoutModal />`, Node.js / PHP / Python REST APIs (`/api/v1/payments/orders`), Hosted Payment Links (`/pay/:orderId`), and WooCommerce Plugin
- **Important Legal Positioning:** SumioPay holds ₹0.00 of customer or merchant funds and is purely B2B software automation — not a commercial bank, RBI-licensed Payment Aggregator, nodal operator, or NPCI entity.
